headline: 3-year-old boy's body found in sack in Shariatpur
summary: The child went missing after leaving home to play; police have detained a neighbor for questioning following allegations of a dispute.
details: The throat-slit body of three-year-old Sowaif Hossain was recovered from a ditch in the Paschim Adasan area of Sidhalkura union, Damudya upazila, Shariatpur.
The child had gone missing around 7:00 am after leaving his home to play. Locals spotted the body stuffed in a sack around noon, approximately six hours after he disappeared.
Police have detained Russel Shikdar, a 45-year-old neighbor, for questioning after the victim's family named several neighbors as suspects.
According to the family, an altercation had occurred between Sowaif's father, Selim Sardar, and neighbor Abu Alam Shikdar on Friday evening over a trivial matter.
The family alleges that the child may have been killed due to this dispute. Following the recovery of the body, agitated locals set fire to Abu Alam's house.
Police are continuing their investigation into other individuals accused by the family to determine the exact circumstances of the crime.

headline_marked: 70 people rescued as [[Gazipur garment factory fire tamed]] after 3.5 hours
headline: 70 people rescued as Gazipur garment factory fire tamed after 3.5 hours
summary: Nine fire service units battled the blaze at Matrix Styles Limited, which lacked an internal firefighting system and nearby water sources.
details: A massive fire broke out at the Matrix Styles Limited garment factory near Fakir Market of Gazi Degir Chala in Gazipur on Saturday afternoon.
The blaze, which started around 2:45 PM on the third floor of the seven-storey building, was brought under control by 6:00 PM.
Nine units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence, including teams from Gazipur Chowrasta, Konabari, and Rajendrapur, were deployed to tackle the flames.
Firefighters successfully rescued 70 people from the building during the operation.
The operation was hindered by the lack of a dedicated firefighting system at the factory and the absence of any ponds or water sources nearby.
Crews are continuing to work to fully extinguish the fire, as fabric stocks in the warehouse must be moved piece by piece to douse the remaining flames.
Officials are currently investigating whether anyone was injured or killed in the incident.
The Fire Service has stated that a detailed inquiry will be conducted to determine the cause of the fire and identify any safety lapses.
caption:

Nine units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence, including teams from Gazipur Chowrasta, Konabari, and Rajendrapur, were deployed to tackle the flames.

Firefighters successfully rescued 70 people from the building during the operation.

The operation was hindered by the lack of a dedicated firefighting system at the factory and the absence of any ponds or water sources nearby.

Crews are continuing to work to fully extinguish the fire, as fabric stocks in the warehouse must be moved piece by piece to douse the remaining flames.

Officials are currently investigating whether anyone was injured or killed in the incident.

The Fire Service has stated that a detailed inquiry will be conducted to determine the cause of the fire and identify any safety lapses.
